**The window opens on a single persistent column.** Column 0, `hldE`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names 99% of them at 0.02 bits. Then columns 1 to 2, `ibsE`, are variable, carried by 54 to 84%, fewest named at column 1, 63%.

**A fork and variable stretch follows at columns 6 to 9**, carried by 46 to 56%, fewest named at column 7, 75%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 82%, and hesitates less there, 0.18 against 0.57 bits. Its most hesitant column, 61, `yghT`, is a fork column, at 1.14 bits.

**The window ends in a fork and variable stretch.** Columns 60 to 79 are carried by 42 to 76%, the most plastic stretch of the window, in a region of plasticity in 54 to 86% of calls. The last column is `glcB`, in 42% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 89% of genes**, 0.33 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.80 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 95%.

label: hldE
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the hldE window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hldE, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 651 to 730 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hldE once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.33 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,733 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 15,061 calls, named 79%, 0.60 bits; cloud 326 calls, named 20%, 3.64 bits. Outside an RGP 31,087 calls, named 95%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 12,033 calls, named 75%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 49 spine, 17 fork, 14 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 95%); 12,033 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 61 (yghT, a fork column) 1.14 bits, RGP 63%; column 62 (yghS, a variable column) 1.10 bits, RGP 69%; column 60 (pitB, a variable column) 1.10 bits, RGP 54%. The 23 columns (columns 7-9 and 60-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.65 bits on average; the other 57 columns: named 93%, 0.20 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 49 spine columns: named 94%, 0.18 bits on average; the 31 fork and variable columns: named 82%, 0.57 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 61, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 60-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 54-86%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: hldE. named 99%; 0.02 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-2 (2 columns) variable: share 54-84%, 1 S, 1 P, RGP 5%. named 63-93% (mean 78%), fewest named at column 1, named 63%; most hesitant at column 2, 0.35 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: ibsE S 54% "type I toxin-antitoxin system Ibs f…"
[S2.c2]    2: ibsE P 84%
[S3] 3. columns 3-5 (3 columns) spine: share 91-95%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 5-6%. Genes: yqiK "flotillin family protein", yqiJ "OB-fold-containig protein", glgS. named 95-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (yqiK), named 95%, 0.39 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 6-9 (4 columns) fork and variable columns: share 46-56%, all S, RGP 45-56%. named 75-90% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 7, named 75%; most hesitant at column 8, 0.94 bits.
[S4.b7]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 7-9, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all S; the branch's families: "pilus protein", "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone", "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…"
[S4.c6]    6 variable: yqiI S 51% "fimbrial protein"

[S6] 6. column 12 variable: share 84%, all S, RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.08 bits.
[S6.c12]    12: yqiD S 84% "protein YqiD"
